info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Loan Application By Offer Id-spec
info.description: This API allows the modification of a loan application associated with a specific offer ID. It supports updating various details of the loan application, enhancing the flexibility for users to manage their applications. Typically used by financial services professionals, this endpoint facilitates adjustments in application status, terms, or other pertinent details necessary for processing. The API ensures that customers can effectively respond to changing circumstances or requirements throughout the loan application lifecycle.

patch.summary: Update an Offer for a Loan Application
patch.description: This operation allows you to update an existing offer associated with a specified loan application. By making a patch request to this endpoint, you can modify specific fields within the offer, enabling you to manage and adjust loan terms based on your business requirements.

requestBody.description: The request body for updating the loan application offer. This should contain the necessary fields to modify existing loan offers associated with the given application. Ensure that the data adheres to the defined schema.

200.description: The request was successful, and the offer has been updated.
